stage.description: Why projects fail, the accidental success of PHP objects, and how the book is organised.

payload.markdown: This short chapter placed objects in their context in the PHP language. The future for PHP is very much bound up with object-oriented design. In the next few chapters, I take a snapshot of PHP’s current support for object features and introduce some design issues.
